Security verdict: PASS WITH NOTES
PR: #256
Head: 695aae4a4033941c44dfead656ef070febf9fef9

No high-confidence introduced security vulnerabilities found. Read-only inspection covered all 23 changed-file diffs, the complete new audit script, affected production boundaries, the PR body, and the before-audit note at governance commit 1cba5d70. C33's user-account trust boundary and C34's bounded review scope apply. No product, protected model-cost, or governance files were edited by hand.

Security receipts:
- harness/scripts/cache-ttl-audit.py:67-92 opens SQLite mode=ro and selects event/seat metadata with bound window parameters, not message bodies or credential/account columns. Lines 100-135 retain usage/model/cache/timing data and select conversation-agent usage. IMPORTANT: lines 119-123 physically read raw transcript lines before filtering; "metadata-only" describes extraction/output, not physical I/O. No transcript message-body fields or raw records are serialized.
- harness/scripts/cache-ttl-audit.py:183-202,229-250 emits grouped statistics; explicit --json writes seat/model/route/timing/token/TTL/classification metadata to a caller-selected local file. It is not anonymized. File permissions follow umask, and an existing destination can be truncated. No new network publication, account object, credential-file access, shell evaluation, or child-process launch is introduced.
- crates/core/src/session_status.rs:269-301 preserves native/split evidence before proxy and the versioned table. Lines 25,330-331,361-364 establish wire v2 and default missing v1 TTL facts to unknown.
- crates/core/src/cold_wake.rs:204-209 constructs TTL text from numeric/enum facts; 233-280 retains the >400,000 threshold and unknown-after-five-minutes warning; 349-371 keeps table-only evidence insufficient for warm-flush/cheap-revive positive cache knowledge.
- crates/daemon/src/http/cold_wake.rs:185-195,211-264 trims/rejects empty force reasons, refuses cold unforced delivery, and persists the forced-wake audit before delivery; audit failure prevents proceeding. crates/daemon/src/pa_watchdog.rs:331-375 likewise propagates audit failure.
- Wire/log changes include derived coldWake.warning, refusal details and forced-wake cache_ttl metadata, not just cacheTtlSeconds and basis. No raw transcript, credential, account object, or new endpoint is exposed (crates/core/src/cold_wake.rs:145-185,455-495; crates/daemon/src/http/cold_wake.rs:239-258).
- Complete diff inventory confirms no edits to crates/cli/src/fleet_report* or docs/how/prompt-cache-cost.md. New rendering markers are allowlisted literals (.omp/extensions/pij/core/roster-table.ts:41-44; crates/cli/src/roster.rs:39-44).

Cost, with evidence grades:
- Source inspection: no new production timer/poll, process-launch site, or transcript read per existing status invocation. The existing source.status() read is followed by an in-memory lookup over at most five table rows (crates/daemon/src/http/mod.rs:3736-3784). Added launches/second: zero; added per-seat scheduled work: none. This is source evidence, not a before/after live measurement.
- The audit is on demand under nice -n 19 (justfile:226-227). It performs four SELECTs, reads report tables, scans selected Copilot transcripts, sorts per-seat calls, and reconstructs call-time arrays per delivery. Pairing includes sum(deliveries_per_seat * calls_per_seat); neither transcript I/O nor wall-clock/memory cost is proven window-bounded (harness/scripts/cache-ttl-audit.py:69-150).
- Author's before-audit note at 1cba5d70 records the November 12-19, 2026 03:36 UTC window: fleet-report, --since 7d --threads 2, exit 0, 107188 calls / 16757 turns / 755 sessions; prototype audit exit 0, 14620 delivered / 13404 paired / 9402 decided. These are work-volume receipts, not elapsed/CPU/RSS/launch-rate measurements, and the prototype receipt does not prove execution of the committed script. No live audit was run by this review.

Validation:
- Independently ran just pr-freeze 256: exit 0, FINAL at the full head above; gh and ls-remote agree, main/CLEAN/not draft, all checks passing, clean detached worktree. No migrations added; schema version remains 47.
- Pre-publication recheck briefly returned exit 1 for GitHub merge state UNKNOWN after another PR merged; the next just pr-freeze 256 returned exit 0, CLEAN and FINAL at the unchanged head. No failed build or test was retried.
- Delegated read-only review inspected exact-head CI run 44457705817: check (22), check (24), rust-lint and rust-test succeeded. Delivers run 44457707511 succeeded. These are job/step outcomes; individual JUnit cases were not independently enumerated.
- No local builds, tests, harness boot/checks, runtime exploit probes, or live-store audits were executed. Static inspection plus CI is not deployed-behavior or provider-expiry proof.

Nonblocking qualifications and obligation:
- PAST_TTL=Refuse is a conservative cold-wake brake: removing it permits the same or more wakes. The chosen treatment of expired cache is deliberate and awaiting the prime; this security pass does not resolve that ruling.
- The false-cold increase and provider-real expiry accuracy remain the correctness review's question; a security pass does not establish that actually warm seats are never refused.
- OWED, owner role:security: after merge AND deployment, collect the deployment timestamp, run the committed cache-TTL audit over a post-deploy window (at least three days), compare silent-cold/false-cold and large-seat outcomes, inspect warning/forced-wake receipts, and publish f214-audit-after to pm-001. Preserve output privacy and include actual elapsed/resource receipts. This obligation is not discharged by replay or CI.

Harness feedback:
magicWand: validate delegated security reports for full head, per-check file:line evidence, actual commands and proof limits before accepting completion.
difficulties: the initial delegated report was verdict-only; one same-context follow-up recovered the retained evidence without a second review. Captured as DL-001 in this review worktree's transient harness buffer. Review used exact-head CI/finality rather than prohibited local gates.
